en: Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and not accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six under root, six under predominance … pe … three under mutuality … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and without applied thought but with sustained thought, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable and non-reactive nor without applied thought but with sustained thought, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six under root; six under predominance … pe … three under mutuality … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and without applied thought or sustained thought, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable, not non-reactive, and not without applied thought and sustained thought, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
